<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
  <parent>
    <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
    <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
    <version>4.1.1</version>
    <relativePath/>
  </parent>
  <groupId>cn.memorygarden</groupId>
  <artifactId>memory-game6085</artifactId>
  <version>1.0.0</version>
  <name>memory-game6085</name>
  <description>记忆花园：Docker 课程翻牌小游戏</description>
  <properties><java.version>21</java.version></properties>
  <dependencies>
    <dependency><groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId><artifactId>spring-boot-starter-webmvc</artifactId></dependency>
    <dependency><groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId><artifactId>spring-boot-starter-validation</artifactId></dependency>
    <dependency><groupId>org.xerial</groupId><artifactId>sqlite-jdbc</artifactId><version>3.53.4.0</version></dependency>
    <dependency><groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId><artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId><scope>test</scope></dependency>
  </dependencies>
  <build>
    <finalName>memory-game6085</finalName>
    <plugins>
      <plugin><groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId><artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId></plugin>
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId><artifactId>maven-resources-plugin</artifactId>
        <executions><execution><id>copy-vue</id><phase>process-resources</phase><goals><goal>copy-resources</goal></goals>
          <configuration><outputDirectory>${project.build.outputDirectory}/static</outputDirectory>
            <resources><resource><directory>../frontend/dist</directory><filtering>false</filtering></resource></resources>
          </configuration>
        </execution></executions>
      </plugin>
    </plugins>
  </build>
</project>
source_zip.dockerfile:
FROM node:24-bookworm-slim AS frontend
WORKDIR /build/frontend
COPY frontend/package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
COPY frontend/ ./
RUN npm run build

FROM maven:3.9.9-eclipse-temurin-21 AS backend
WORKDIR /build/backend
COPY backend/pom.xml ./
RUN mvn -B -ntp dependency:go-offline
COPY backend/src ./src
COPY --from=frontend /build/frontend/dist /build/frontend/dist
RUN mvn -B -ntp package

FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jre-jammy
RUN groupadd --system garden && useradd --system --gid garden --home-dir /app garden \
    && mkdir -p /app/data && chown -R garden:garden /app
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=backend --chown=garden:garden /build/backend/target/memory-game6085.jar /app/app.jar
USER garden
ENV DATA_DIR=/app/data PORT=8080
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=70.0", "-jar", "/app/app.jar"]
source_zip.compose:
name: memory-game6085
services:
  garden:
    build: .
    image: memory-game6085:1.0.0
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${GARDEN_PORT:-18085}:8080"
    environment:
      DATA_DIR: /app/data
    volumes:
      - garden-data:/app/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 15s
volumes:
  garden-data:
    name: memory-game6085-data
